overview: In Wild Kratts, the Kratt brothers go around the world looking for animals and use "creature power suits", suits created by their friend, Aviva, out of the creatures' DNA. There are three villains in the show, Zach Varmitech, who controls the creatures' minds and use them as slaves, Donita Donata, who freezes creatures and sell them alive as jewelry, and Gourmond, who makes expensive gourmet dishes out of endangered species. The Kratts usually use their creature powers to foil these three villains' plots.
title: Wild Kratts

overview: Known in Japan as Shingeki no Kyojin, many years ago, the last remnants of humanity were forced to retreat behind the towering walls of a fortified city to escape the massive, man-eating Titans that roamed the land outside their fortress. Only the heroic members of the Scouting Legion dared to stray beyond the safety of the walls – but even those brave warriors seldom returned alive. Those within the city clung to the illusion of a peaceful existence until the day that dream was shattered, and their slim chance at survival was reduced to one horrifying choice: kill – or be devoured!
title: Attack on Titan

overview: Stop motion animated comedy series based on the hit comic-horror novels of the same name. It follows a teenage werewolf, vampire and mummy.
title: Scream Street

overview: Gameoverse is an action drama about video game worlds!!! And their heat death. Only one Cat girl can save them by... helping the villains?
title: Gameoverse

overview: Famous and obscure monsters talk to camera and introduce us to their worlds. They tell us all sorts of fun facts and theories about themselves — where they come from, how they became famous, and how they feel about their reputations
title: I'm a Monster

overview: After traveling to what appears to be a true Tang Dynasty world, the main character Ning Que discovers that it is actually a perilous agricultural world. He first believed that he could become superior and live a luxurious lifestyle, but he discovers that he lacks cultivation skills. He was also persecuted for thousands of miles and saw his entire family massacred when he was four years old. He discovered the baby Sangsang while he was running away from death and picked up a black umbrella in a sea of blood and dead. He discovered the will to live in despair. He takes the large black umbrella and Sangsang and launches an exciting counterattack, refusing to submit to fate.
title: Jiang Ye

overview: The series will serve as a companion to the original Adventure Time, featuring brand-new adventures for Finn and Jake that aim to "capture the spirit" of the show's earlier years. While Adventure Timewent on to include traditional, episode-spanning story arcs, Adventure Time: Side Quests looks as though it will contain far more self-contained adventures. The new series aims to introduce a new generation of fans to the world of Ooo while still appealing to older fans eager to jump back into the franchise they grew up with.
title: Adventure Time: Side Quests

overview: After a magnetic storm strikes the Blue Star Continent, spiritual energy is revived, transforming both humans and animals. This triggers a battle for survival between spirit beasts and humans. Ling Tian, a young prodigy with an ancient divine bloodline and a treasure called the 'God Brain,' discovers that in three years, the continent will face a disaster that will lead to his heroic death. Guided by Yan Ling, his assistant from the future, he embarks on a mission to attain ultimate power and change the continent's fate.
title: Zhanshen Lianmeng

overview: Punie is next in line to become queen of Magical Land. However, she must spend a year on Earth before she can inherit the throne, so she transfers into a school in Japan. She's usually a sweet and gentle girl... that is unless someone does something to displease her, then she'll drop the act. She won't hesitate to whip out her magic stick and cheerfully rain bloody destruction down on the hapless fool, or barring that, simply use wrestling moves she calls "Submission" to punish them. Accompanied by her animal mascot Paya-tan, who makes regular attempts on her life (still bitter about being defeated and then forcibly recruited from Waku Waku Mascot Village), and forced to fend off random attacks by various people from her Kingdom who all have different reasons for wanting her dead, she must complete this year of training on Earth without fail.
title: Magical Witch Punie-Chan

overview: A student's typical teenage life is disrupted by disturbing dreams and bizarre occurrences. After meeting a strange girl that resides in an alternate reality, they set out together seeking answers as to the true nature of both their worlds.
title: Interlude

overview: One day while walking home, Yuuri Suzuki is magically pulled through a puddle of water and finds herself in the past, or more precisely 1500 B.C. Location: The Hittite Empire, Anatolia. There the queen was to use her as a sacrifice, but she was saved by the queen's stepson, who is also a heir to the throne. Now she must try to stay alive and get back to her time while hopefully not altering the future.
title: Red River

overview: Proving that one is never too young to headline their own series, Fox and Hulu have given a two-season order to Stewie, a spinoff of global juggernaut Family Guy centered on the Griffins' evil genius toddler son. The new animated comedy, will follow Stewie in preschool and explore time and space travel.
title: Stewie

overview: A relatable cupcake and her friends face the hilarious and thrilling challenges of a sleepover, with unexpected twists at every corner.
title: Cupcake & Friends

overview: Based on pocket.watch creator partner Diana, the most followed girl in the world on YouTube, this young band of K-pop space-traveling musicians races to Planet Goo, where they must perform a concert to restore the music and save the aliens.
title: Love, Diana Music Hunters

overview: A lovable punk duck and his best friend, Smiley Cat, tear through a wildly exaggerated Los Angeles, hilariously stumbling into alien invasions, giant monsters, robot criminal conspiracies, telenovela-style family drama, and supernatural mayhem—all while trying (and usually failing) to do the right thing.
title: Punky Duck

overview: The story unfolds in a fantastical martial arts world where ordinary people can unleash their mental and physical potential through continuous martial arts practice and internal energy cultivation. The protagonist, Lin Chen, is an ordinary martial artist of humble origins who strives for the pinnacle of skill. After experiencing injustice, his anger triggers his inner mental potential, entering a state of "Mind Awareness" similar to a quantum effect. However, this also allows him to witness the terrible danger his family faces in the future. Therefore, to protect his family and loved ones from fatal harm and to investigate the mystery of his father's disappearance, Lin Chen uses a mysterious list as a clue to uncover the truth behind everything, engaging in a perilous and arduous struggle against evil forces, thus weaving a legendary and moving tale.
title: Long Po Jiutian

overview: Care Bears keep watch over the earth to keep bad feelings at bay. Whenever a kid is feeling down, they are there to help bring a smile to the child's face. They live in a city in the sky, named Care-A-Lot. They hold meetings in the Hall of Caring to discuss important matters. Their cousins live in the Forest of Feelings. The Care Bear Cousins' leader is Braveheart Lion. Each bear and cousin has a special power, related to the symbol on its tummy. When they unite, they can use the Care Bear Stare to beam good energy at their enemies, such as No Heart, Professor Cold Heart, Shrieky, and Beastly. The bears have two modes of transportation, Cloudmobiles and Rainbow Rollers, which they fly down to earth on whenever there is trouble. They are alerted to problems by the Care-O-Meter. The Care Bears Family combined old episodes of Care Bears with new ones.
title: Care Bears

overview: In HexVets and Magic Pets, kid witches Annette and Clarion are thrilled to become HexVet apprentices to the kind, clever, and sometimes cheeky Dr. Talon. At her clinic, they learn how to heal and care for magical creatures while picking up some important social-emotional lessons themselves. Annette and Clarion are unlikely friends that couldn't be more different - she's all drive and he leads with his heart - but through their comical adventures, they find they're stronger together. Part magical procedural, part creature comedy, and all heart, HexVets and Magic Pets is a series about persisting after failure, celebrating differences, and bringing all the magic you can into the world.
title: HexVets and Magic Pets

overview: In the late 1970s, in a small provincial town, girls Manyunya and Narine live a joyful and adventurous life. Their everyday life is filled with pranks, friendship, the first childhood worries, and amusing misunderstandings that invariably involve adults: the strict but kind Granny, dad Misha, and Narine's parents, Nadya and Yura. Narine's younger sister, Karinka the "meteor," and her eternal "victim," Rubik, join the gang, making the stories even more unpredictable. From trying to tame a kitten and fix a car to playing "adults" and staging their own theatrical productions, the girls learn friendship, mutual support, and responsibility. Their pranks often turn into funny and sometimes even instructive lessons, but most importantly, Manyunya and Narine always stay together, turning their childhood into a true fairy tale.
title: Манюня

overview: Welcome to Yani's apartment. Please don't mind the smell. Yani is a catgirl with a seriously bad smoking habit. Every time she tries to quit, she becomes weak to the cravings and gives in almost instantly. Behind on her rent and unable to hold down a job, her friends and sister rally around to help her out. But when she's using her pee to put out cigarette fires, they may just have their work cut out for them.
title: Yani Neko

overview: Thirty years ago, the sudden appearance of unknown invasive alien lifeforms nearly brought about the end of the world. Since then, humanity and these creatures, known as Invasion Species, have continued to clash over living territory. Although human safety is barely being maintained, the world remains on the brink of collapse. As the threat of death and destruction lingers, people go about their daily lives by turning away from the constant danger around them. In response, the United Nations establishes EXCEEDS, an organization tasked with investigating and combating threats caused by the Invasion Species. The story begins in the Far Eastern island nation of Mizuho, where Shiina Kuze, a young hunter who exterminates invasive species, lives on a remote island. Wanting nothing more than a quiet life with her only family—her younger sister, Setsuna—Shiina's routine is disrupted when an unexpected incident occurs, drawing her into a much larger conflict.
title: Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha EXCEEDS Gun Blaze Vengeance

overview: Human civilization plunged into a digital Stone Age when the space travelers, the Architectons, stripped humanity of its technology. The world, entangled in networks and chips, suddenly became dark and silent. But even in the darkest times, there are those who refuse to give up. The young and precocious Zabava, along with her AI friend Zhuzha, embark on a desperate mission. Their goal is not only to recover lost knowledge but also to find Zabava's missing mother. The key to salvation lies in her father's invention—a time machine. The journey leads to the distant and mysterious 21st century—an era of technological advancement. Here, Zabava will make many discoveries: why food spoils and what an "expiration date" is, why cows need "mood statistics," and how farmers monitor plant health and understand where to grow a bountiful harvest.
title: Не может быть! или приключения Забавы

overview: A savant salesman. A gentle gladiator. A quiet virtuoso. A summoner of the divine. And the poor soul who hired them. All part of the staff at Dealies, a big box store. They are masters of the delicate alchemy of trade. Prophets of enterprise. And occasionally they do some actual work.
title: Dealies

overview: In Earthclear, everyone is born into a fixed role, and villagers are the weakest of all. Most never rise above Level 5—except Koji Kagami, who is Level…999?! On a monster hunt, he meets Alice, the Demon King's daughter, and discovers they share an impossible dream: coexistence between humans and demons. In a world destined for conflict, they charge into battle to defy fate and shatter the rules.
title: The Villager of Level 999

overview: Feudal Japan is attacked by beasts called 'Youi'. Ryuudou Yukiatsu, a 'floater' and an employee at a bath house has the power of Ayagami ("The power to find the words behind things") which can be used in fighting against the Youi. That's why the members of a Youi-fighting group Bansha Aratamesho, called the Ayashi, are looking for Yukiatsu - they want him to become an Ayashi as well. Yukiatsu runs into a woman and a son who are chased by a Youi and has to face the past he's been running away from.
title: Ghost Slayers Ayashi

overview: The great sage Ephtal dies in despair after failing to reach the peak of magic—but 400 years later, he's reborn with all his memories and power intact! In a world where magic has decayed and ancient spells are treated as miracles, Ephtal storms into a prestigious magic academy to reclaim the true art of sorcery. As his power shakes the world, long-forgotten legends begin to awaken!
title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage

overview: Teenager Brett Mathews ran off the road during a thunderstorm into a too secret government facility hitting a lazer infusing him with his sports car. When hot he would morph into a sports car and cold back into a boy. His two friends, and his dog together would solve mysteries.
title: Turbo Teen

overview: The adorable Best Popple Pals love helping their friends and neighbors, but every time they do it seems to backfire in hilarious ways.
title: Popples

overview: In 1800, it was the period they called it the end of the Edo Era. People were swaying between the ideologies of evolutionism and conservatism. In these conflicts, there were men acting in the dark side of the society. They had the latest repeating guns, wore black helmets, and their movement were far beyond that of a normal person, this group was called "Samurai Gun". They were welcomed by the citizens, but they had another plan. They were an armed troop organized to topple the Edo government. Nanagomaru Ichimatsu was the member of Samurai Gun. His older sister was killed. He was involved in the wave of ages not understanding the true meaning of fighting. Their mission was to kill evils in shadow as well as in the sun. Where is true justice? What is evil that they should hate? Where is Japan heading?
title: Samurai Gun

overview: Duke Togo is a professional assassin. His age and birthplace are unknown and there is no consensus in the worldwide intelligence community as to his true identity. Most of his jobs are completed through the use of a customized, scoped M16 rifle.
title: Golgo 13

overview: While visiting Japan on the ultimate foodie adventure, Scooby-Doo and Shaggy unwittingly unleash hundreds of mythical monsters that are causing trouble across the country. With the help of Scooby's uncle, Daisuke-Doo, along with new friends, a magical girl Yume, and gadget whiz Takumi, the group embarks on an all-new mystery filled with monster chasing and fun chaos.
title: YoKoSo Scooby-Doo!

overview: A hungry wolf desperately tries the craziest tricks to get to his favourite prey, the sheep. But the predator, despite all the schemes he employs, never succeeds and never satisfies his hunger.
title: Tendres Agneaux

overview: Set in a contemporary world in a medieval kingdom, Long Live the Royals follows a fictional British Royal Family—King Rufus and Queen Eleanor and their children Peter, Rosalind, and Alex—as they honor the annual Yule Hare Festival. The family must battle having to rule their kingdom while maintaining a normal family at the same time. Meanwhile, the festival continues with the parties and feasts that comprise it.
title: Long Live the Royals

overview: This exciting new animated series is inspired by the beloved Doctor Who universe. It marks the first time the ‘Whoniverse' has been expanded into an animated series for pre-school audiences.
title: Doctor Who

overview: It has been 35 years since Lin Minmei brought peace between the Zentradi and the humans. Basara and his band "Fire Bomber" are a struggling up and coming group on the Macross 7, an intergalactic colony ship traveling through space looking for a new planet to call home. During its flight, an unknown alien race appeared and started laying siege upon the colony. However, its attacks are not conventional - instead of trying to destroy them, they steal what is known as "spiritia", leaving victims in a catatonic state. Basara, yearning to have his music heard, flies into the battle zone in his Valkerie to spread the message of music.
title: Macross 7

overview: After transmigrating to the Xianjiang Continent, Yi Feng discovers that he was born without a spiritual root, making cultivation impossible. With no choice but to rely on the "essential life skills" granted by a mysterious system, he struggles to make a living in this world of cultivators. What Yi Feng doesn't realize, however, is that in the eyes of powerful cultivators, his abilities are nothing short of godlike. Every casual action he takes unknowingly influences the fate of the entire continent. As he effortlessly resolves one crisis after another without realizing his true impact, Yi Feng creates countless thrilling and hilarious moments, bringing new opportunities, hope, and choices to the people of the Xianjiang Continent.
title: Above Myriads

overview: Unremarkably ordinary middle schoolers, Pyontaro, Hiroshi and Tsubame, wander into an extraordinary adventure when Pyontaro's little sister goes missing.
title: Thunder 3

overview: Insects are taken up into space for use in experiments by humans. The development plans and experiments are aborted by humans for no known reason, the organisms are left behind in the space station with limited resources. Going over hurdles and fighting through challenges, Mick and his friends travel across planets and gain new comrades, heading for Earth.
title: Space Bug

overview: Calling all Monsters! Do YOU love to DANCE? Come join the fuzzy, friendly, funky fun with Toots, Teeny and Razzle Dazzle, as they get down.
title: Jim Henson's Monster Dance

overview: Jiro Azuma is no average high schooler. A descendant of ninjas and trained in the ancient warrior art of the shinobi, Jiro is also able to talk with animals. After a mysterious encounter with an injured cat named Rago, Jiro discovers the feline is actually the legendary Black Star of Doom! Joined by the Bureau of Espionage, they fight off swarms of mononoke lying in wait to exploit Rago's powers.
title: Black Torch

overview: Following World War V, a global-scale conflict fought with non-nuclear weapons that almost halved the earth's population, the city-nation of Olympus stands as a beacon of hope in a world of chaos. The utopian metropolis is governed by Gaia, a vast artificial intelligence, and administered by genetically engineered humanoids known as bioroids. Although Olympus seems like a peaceful city on the surface, racial (human vs. bioroids vs. cyborgs), religious, and political conflicts lurk underneath -threatening to overturn the delicately balanced peace of this so-called utopia.
title: Appleseed XIII

overview: Scott Free is the world's greatest escape artist, known to the world as Mister Miracle, whose perfect life with his warrior wife Big Barda falls apart when their two home worlds — Apocalypse and New Genesis — go to war and Scott's cruel adoptive father Darkseid appears to have captured the ultimate weapon, the Anti-Life Equation, that will give him total dominance over the universe.
title: Mister Miracle

overview: 10-year-old Martha Stewart and her friends learn how to make the holidays special with Martha's unique brand of do-it-yourself magic.
title: Martha and Friends

overview: A low-ranking prince scorned as incompetent. His true identity is—the seventh prince of the powerful Ardrasia Empire. Arnold, the seventh prince of this empire, was known as the "Dust-Drained Prince" because his twin brother, Leonard, was so talented that he had sucked everything out of him. In the midst of the intensifying struggle for the throne following the sudden death of the first prince, who was the crown prince, Arnold decides to get serious, thinking, "I don't want to die, so I'll just make my brother emperor." While playing the role of the incompetent "Dust-Drained Prince" on the public stage, he secretly operates with overwhelming power as "Silver," one of only five SS-rank adventurers on the continent, and controls the struggle for the throne from the shadows.
title: The Insipid Prince's Furtive Grab for The Throne

overview: Carolina, overshadowed by her prime minister father and mage sister, accepts her quiet fate, but a royal decree forces her into marriage with a fearsome prince. Amid political danger, she discovers true love and her own hidden power.
title: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power

overview: When a giant robot invades 22nd-century Earth and threatens to destroy humanity, only a special unit of security immigration officers can stop it.
title: Melty Lancer

overview: The story takes place in Japan in the early 21st century, in an alternate reality where the Tokugawa Shogunate has remained in power. In this reality, student councils are tasked with oppressing schools. Yagyuu Muneakira is a high school student who rebels against his student council with the help of girls who've had the names of famous samurai heroes passed on to them.
title: Hyakka Ryouran: Samurai Girls

overview: Young dolphin Jim is tasked with steering the world's first submarine on wheels.
title: Submarine Jim

overview: When two curious siblings venture into a forbidden, cursed mountain forest in search of local legend, they unexpectedly stumble upon Dara-san—a terrifying, half-human, half-snake demon. Instead of devouring them, the ancient spirit takes them in for a sleepover, kicking off a supernatural comedy about an unknowable horror adapting to everyday domestic life.
title: Dara-san of Reiwa

overview: A banished mermaid princess, who dissolved into bubbles after a failed forbidden romance with a human, is reborn in modern-day Japan. Teaming up with a high school boxer, she must navigate human society and successfully find true love to complete her second chance at life.
title: Goodbye, Lara

overview: Set in 1950s Japan, Grow Up Show follows a group of cheerful yet resilient girls who belong to a wandering circus troupe struggling to survive financially. As they travel from town to town, performing under harsh conditions, the girls confront reality, responsibility, and personal growth—learning what it truly means to grow up while chasing dreams beneath the circus tent.
title: Grow Up Show -Sunflower Circus-

overview: Reincarnated into modern Japan, a lazy former demon king trying to live a quiet life as a NEET gamer finds his peace shattered when the hero who defeated him—now a high school girl—tracks him down to resume their battle, forcing them into an unexpected romance.
title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life

overview: Chosen by prophecy to be the kingdom's holy savior, a defiant heroine takes a job as an all-works maid instead, forcing a bewildered crown prince to court a servant who is far more interested in perfect laundry than saving the world.
title: Heroine? Saint? No, I'm an All-Works Maid (And Proud of It)!

overview: A shy, ostracized high school girl with a rare, mysterious illness must navigate her first crush on the class idol while trying to keep her massive, terrifying secret under wraps: anytime she gets romantically worked up or embarrassed, her body transforms into a giant, destructive kaiju.
title: Kaiju Girl Caramelise

overview: An introverted, disillusioned university student finds his life transformed after meeting an optimistic blind woman. As they bond over fulfilling her bucket list—including a dream to see fireworks—they must navigate a bittersweet romance cut short by the return of her childhood illness.
title: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky

overview: When a meteorite shower strikes Earth releasing miracle-granting dust, it accelerates economic disparity and triggers violent terrorism. Amidst the chaos, three high schoolers navigate their seemingly normal downtown lives... while training for a specialized anti-terrorist squad.
title: Mebius Dust

overview: A normal, struggling high school boy gets swept up in a kidnapping plot involving a billionaire's daughter. He is subsequently hired as her live-in caretaker. While she must project the image of a flawless, brilliant student at school, he must secretly manage her completely hopeless daily life at home.
title: Rich Girl Caretaker: I'm Secretly the Caregiver of the Most Popular Girl in This Rich Kid School

overview: An arranged marriage. Two complete strangers. One adorable romance! When cheerful noblewoman Elsa is suddenly wed to the reserved duke-to-be Julius, neither expects their political marriage to spark something more. As awkward misunderstandings, sweet gestures, and growing feelings pile up, these newlyweds discover that falling in love might be the easiest—and hardest—part of married life.
title: The Duke's Son Claims He Won't Love Me Yet Showers Me with Adoration

overview: In a world where humans and ayakashi–supernatural beings–coexist, being chosen as an ayakashi's bride is the ultimate honor. Yuzu, an ordinary schoolgirl, has been overlooked her whole life, eclipsed by the shadow of her sister Karin, a chosen bride. Just when Yuzu has had enough, she unexpectedly captures the heart of Reiya, a dashing ogre from a powerful clan who claims Yuzu as his own.
title: The Ogre's Bride

overview: Ito Narita's life is turned upside down when her mother remarries. Moving into a new household, she suddenly becomes the older sister to four unique younger stepbrothers, navigating the chaotic, heartwarming dynamics of her blended family and slowly growing closer to her aloof but kind eldest stepbrother.
title: Please Excuse My Younger Brothers

overview: After a fatal accident, overworked office worker Arihito Atobe is reborn in the Labyrinth Country as a Seeker with the rare Rearguard class—an all-purpose support role that excels in attack, defense, and healing. Joined by a fierce demi-human mercenary and his former boss, Arihito dives into deadly dungeons and rises through the ranks. The adventure of the strongest support class begins!
title: The World's Strongest Rearguard

overview: In an age when spies act behind the scenes in every land, Chloe spends her days successfully carrying out even the most difficult missions due to her unparalleled disguise skills and martial arts abilities. However, after the betrayal of her boss, she suddenly disappears—as Chloe plans to redo her life as the ordinary citizen Victoria in the neighboring kingdom of Ashberry, striving for a "normal" life. However, Victoria's peaceful life is abruptly cut short as she begins to get involved with many people. In this new land, her experiences and abilities from her days as a spy come in far more useful than she ever expected!! On the other hand, the second prince and the pursuer of the organization amongst others take an interest in Victoria's strength, and many shadows close in on the one with all the cards in her hand...!
title: Victoria of Many Faces

overview: At a prestigious, ultra-refined girls' academy, a scholarship student discovers that her elegant, flawless idol is secretly a ruthless, trash-talking fighting game champion. Bound by a mutual love for competitive gaming—which is strictly forbidden on campus—the two unlikely friends dive into no-holds-barred video game combat.
title: Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games

overview: The series introduces a new generation of young fans to the iconic world of Masters of the Universe through fast-paced, action-packed mini adventures. Tales from Eternia delivers high-stakes clashes between He-Man, Skeletor, and Eternia's iconic heroes and villains, bringing the timeless conflict between good and evil to life for today's audiences.
title: Masters of the Universe: Tales from Eternia

overview: At multiple crime scenes where humans turn into demonic beings, the prime suspect caught on camera is the spitting image of the male lead. Armed with an underworld arrest warrant, the female lead detains him to face Heibai Wuchang's judgment. Desperate to prove his innocence, the male lead blackmails the female lead into helping him seek the truth. As they dig deeper, they expose a chilling conspiracy behind the cases and the killer's link to the male lead. What they don't know is that every move they make is part of a mastermind's design...
title: Cheng Huang Lu

overview: In an enviromentally wrecked future Tokyo, a young man named Ken Ando joins an organization called DC. Little does he realize that his fate and that of Earth will be linked to a mysterious mecha from another world.
title: Masou Kishin Cybuster

overview: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious "red phone card" left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya—who possessed the same card—suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as "PSYЯEN." When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins—one that will change his fate forever.
title: PSYREN

overview: After that fateful night, Tatsuhiko posts a new animation on social media and soon finds that it's gone viral! His favorite musician, Nico, reaches out and asks him to collaborate on a music video for one of her songs. At their first meeting, Tatsuhiko is shocked to discover that he recognizes Nico from the night that changed everything…
title: BEAT & MOTION

overview: A young man, Toshiro Kamiya, lives in poverty and works hard to pay taxes, cover living expenses, and afford medication for his mentally ill mother. However, the cruel reality around him gradually eats away at his hope. Living... there isn't a single thing fun about it. In this dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of the "Spiriflor" — the plants that humans transform into. Should he continue living as a human being, or cast off his suffering and start a new life as a plant? Which path would you choose in his situation?
title: Fool Night

overview: Princess Bubblegum and Marceline the Vampire Queen journey across the farthest reaches of Ooo, encountering familiar faces and new dangers.
title: Adventure Time: Bubblegum and Marceline

overview: In 1374, amid the turmoil of the Northern and Southern Courts' long running conflict, a boy named Oniyasha is born into a family of sarugaku theater performers. He spends his days in a kind of quiet gloom, haunted by a simple but persistent question: Why do people dance? Then, one day, he witnesses a dance that he feels to be "good"—and everything begins to change. This is the story of the beautiful young boy who would one day shape the art of Noh and be remembered as Zeami.
title: The World Is Dancing

overview: Welcome to the Charmswell School for Royal Magic! Spend time with Sofia and her Royal Friends, where she takes you on a sparkling tour of her brand-new royal school, where every castle shines with its own special kind of magic. Along the way, she'll introduce you to her old and new friends — Pepper, Clover, Layla, Zane, and Camila — each with amazing talents and magical gifts of their own. With Sofia as your guide, there's no better way to discover the magic of Charmswell!
title: Sofia the First: Magical Friends

overview: Class is back in session for Phineas and Ferb! But that doesn't mean the fun has to end. From inside school lockers, we follow everyone's favorite brothers on new adventures.
title: Locker Diaries: Phineas and Ferb

overview: Elizabeth Leiston, the daughter of Haldoria's powerful prime minister, is the picture of a refined noble lady and the perfect future queen. But when her fiancé publicly humiliates her, calls off their engagement, and starts spreading nasty rumors about her, Elizabeth reaches her breaking point. Why should her only friend be her loyal maid, and why should she continue to serve a country that doesn't respect her? Elizabeth concludes she won't stand it any longer and will bring down the kingdom, even if it's the last thing she does! As such, she uses her quick wit and, more importantly, her seven magic grimoires to embark on a quest for revenge. And let her tell you, there will be hell to pay!
title: A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires

overview: Metalocalypse is an eleven-minute flash animated comedy airing on Cartoon Network's Adult Swim, created by Brendon Small and Tommy Blacha. The series follows the exploits of a fictitious half American/half Scandinavian death metal band known as Dethklok. The band and its members are huge the world over, but incredibly stupid - a death metal version of Spinal Tap. Watch as they leave a trail of destruction and mayhem in their wake with their ear-melting onslaught of metal!
title: Metalocalypse

overview: When the world around you isn't what it seems, you may be in the midst of a Bug Man; powerful being who can warp the very nature of one's memories. The Memory Collectors are here to bring order... whether we like it or not.
title: False Memory

overview: The Ratties is a British animated series following a chaotic family of six rats who live behind the skirting board of a country house. Full of dubious initiative, the rats hilariously try to emulate the activities of their human hosts, but their illogical minds consistently produce funny and disastrously different results.
title: The Ratties

overview: Pocket Monsters, or Pokémon for short. Mysterious creatures of this planet. They can be seen everywhere—in the sky, the sea, the forests, and even in the cities. Riko, a girl from Paldea who possesses a mysterious pendant. Roy, a boy from Kanto who possesses a mysterious Poké Ball. A new adventure for Riko and Roy begins in the vast world of Pocket Monsters ! What encounters and destinies await them!? This is a story of "discovering" something important through adventure.
title: Pokémon Horizons: The Series

overview: Story of Wei Yuan, once the Qingxuan Emperor's son and the current Human Emperor, who reincarnates as a criminal slave of the Jiangnan Cui family. After awakening his past memories, he seeks revenge on the Cui family that framed him, in order to protect his younger sister Wei Yueyao. Along the way, he uncovers the truth of how he was betrayed by the gods in his previous life, and ultimately breaks through to the pinnacle of cultivation.
title: Wushen Jue Dian

overview: Imperial Navy pilot Kae and her wingmen are tasked with securing a vital mining complex – a routine deployment that soon turns deadly. When sleek, unfamiliar fighters tear through the formation, survival pushes them to their absolute limits.
title: Aeronautica Imperialis

overview: Shin Youngwoo (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game "Satisfy," finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: "Pagma's Successor." He's now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game's most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for….
title: Overgeared

overview: Miya is the illegitimate child of a prominent family. When her mother dies and her father's estate agrees to take her in, she's convinced she knows what awaits her in her new home: a life of servitude and misery at the hands of her wicked stepmother and stepsisters. Yet when she finally meets the women she expects to treat her like dirt, they actually end up being... sweet?! A hilarious and heartfelt comedy that's sure to put a smile on your face!
title: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked

overview: BanG Dream! Yume∞Mita follows the virtual girl band Mugendai Mewtype (Yumemita) as five girls with unique, shining talents struggle to transition from isolated, individual performers into a cohesive musical group. The series explores their shared, fated journey that transcends virtual dreams and concrete reality, aiming for a global debut while dealing with the challenges of navigating, and ultimately surviving, both their digital and real-world struggles.
title: BanG Dream! Yume∞Mita

overview: Ai Yasumi, a first-year high schooler living on the remote island of Izu Ōshima, has one obsession: manga. When she discovers that her long-idolized but reclusive favorite manga creator, Yasuno-sensei, will make a rare appearance at Comitia, Ai doesn't hesitate—she has to meet her hero. But that single decision sets off a chain of encounters that will shatter her assumptions about art, genius, and what it truly means to create.
title: Draw This, Then Die!

overview: A nameless man who is six times more afraid of ghosts than the average person gets swept up with the supernatural. The trouble begins when he crosses paths with Mechako, a fearless girl who runs the Kaiki-gumi, an organization that polices the supernatural. Mechako ropes him into helping her revive the organization. Hilariously strange events and spooky shenanigans abound!
title: Let's go KAIKIGUMI

overview: The war is over, and hero Dias is finally rewarded with land of his own—only to discover it's a barren frontier with no people, no villages, and no sign of civilization. With nothing but endless grassland ahead of him, Dias sets out to build a domain from the ground up. But after meeting Alna, a mysterious girl with a blue horn, his lonely frontier is about to spring to life.
title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects

overview: The story follows Rin Takanashi, a former caregiver in her thirties who is summoned to another world but immediately exiled. Using her "Motor House" skill, she summons a fully stocked modern camper van to cook and solo-camp her way across the fantasy realm.
title: The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Road Trip in Another World

overview: Inheriting the fiery spirit of her legendary father, a passionate girl battles modern disinterest to build the strongest dodgeball team of the Reiwa era, facing off against the descendants of her father's old rivals in explosive, over-the-top matches.
title: Dodgeball Girl Danko
